$comment: Level 10 (pacing pass): Hold the Reliquaries. Both Reliquaries are posted with rival guards and haunted by wolf dens; ward stones on the hills let you keep them. Staged chain: hold both ward stones 60 s, clear both dens, which raises a seer stone on the rival shore of the lake (prayer chain) to win, then keep both Reliquaries two minutes (or break the rival) and grow to 65. Normal aggressive rival, reinforced every four minutes.
name: The Twin Reliquaries
description: Two Reliquaries stand between you and a rival tribe, each posted with rival guards and haunted by wolves. Hold both ward stones, clear both dens, win the seer stone across the lake, keep both Reliquaries for two minutes and grow to 65 followers.

rewards.text: The north ward guards the hill against the rival.
The south ward guards the hill against the rival.
The lake seer stone shows the rival valley.

objectives.text: Pray at both ward stones on the hills and hold them for a minute
Clear both wolf dens by the Reliquaries
Win the seer stone on the rival shore of the lake
Keep people at both Reliquaries with no rival beside them for two minutes
Grow to 65 followers to hold the valley

do.text: Guards stand at both Reliquaries and wolves haunt the hills. Take the ward stones, clear the wolves, then keep people at both Reliquaries.
Rival reinforcements march on the valley.
With the wolves gone, a seer stone rises on the rival shore of the lake.
